Pran Death Anniversary Special
Watch the evergreen classic "Hum Bolega To Bologe Ki Bolta Hai" (ham bolega to bologe ki bolta hai) from the Bollywood movie Kasauti. This memorable song is beautifully sung by the legendary Kishore Kumar and features the iconic trio Amitabh Bachchan, Hema Malini, and the legendary Pran.
On the death anniversary of Pran Sahab, we pay tribute to one of Indian cinema's greatest actors, whose powerful performances and unforgettable screen presence continue to inspire generations.
Song: Hum Bolega To Bologe Ki Bolta Hai (ham bolega to bologe ki bolta hai)
